title: Role Play
text: Students stepped into character as a chef, an astronaut and a teacher.
body:
Role Play let students try on someone else’s day. In a chef’s hat and apron, one child held a bowl and spoke as if the classroom were a kitchen.

Another arrived in a silver space suit, ready for a mission. A third came as a teacher, with a bag, a book and a shawl, standing ready to take the class.

By becoming the character, the children practised words, confidence and a little imagination.
